newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, distant months down.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end mixed, distant months down.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended mixed on Monday, as the market lacked clear direction amid a situation where local investors were shifting their money to the soybean contract, traders said.
Prices ranged from 130 yen lower to 110 yen higher. The benchmark March 1998 contract ended down 60 yen at 15,940 yen per tonne, after falling as low as 15,910.

Distant months were hit by technical selling from individual investors from the opening, traders said. All months hit their 500 yen limit at Friday's close. "We expected some technical selling today," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot March contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.06 per bushel at 0730 GMT, unchanged from Friday's close.
The CBOT soybean futures spot March contract was at $8.29 at 0730 GMT, up from $8.27-1/2 at Friday's close.
